author: Leisler, 1814
habitat: 풀포기가 우거진 땅 위의 오목한 곳(둥지 자리)
summary: 땅 위의 풀포기가 우거진 오목한 곳에 둥지를 트는 작은 종다리로, 한배에 누런 갈색 알을 3~5개 낳는다. 여름에는 주로 곤충을 잡아먹고 겨울에는 씨앗을 먹으며, 겨울을 나러 옮겨 간다. 서식지가 파괴되면서 수가 줄고 있고, 중국, 몽골, 티베트, 이라크, 튀니지, 에티오피아 등지에 분포한다.

points.en: large dark brown patches on the breast sides

art.subject: Greater Short-toed Lark (Calandrella brachydactyla), adult (sexes alike in plumage), as seen on Korean fields during passage in April-May: crown sandy-brown, often warm-tinged, finely streaked dark; pale creamy supercilium and pale eye-ring; upperparts sandy grey-brown streaked dark; median coverts dark-centred, forming a dark bar on the wing; long tertials dark-centred with pale edges; underparts whitish with a buff wash on the breast sides and flanks, the breast largely unstreaked; a dark brown patch on each side of the upper breast; tail dark brown with white outer feathers; stout pointed bill, pinkish horn with a greyish ridge; dark eye; pale pinkish-brown legs.
art.pose: standing on bare ground among grass tufts, side view
art.scene: Korean coastal farmland and dry reclaimed land with short grass tufts in May, during spring passage; no people, buildings or text
views: adult, side view standing on bare ground among grass tufts: sandy streaked upperparts, pale supercilium, dark median-covert bar, long tertials covering the primaries, whitish unstreaked breast with a dark breast-side patch, stout pinkish bill with a grey ridge, dark tail with white edges
adult, front view standing: whitish breast and belly with a buff wash, a dark brown patch on each side of the upper breast, otherwise almost unstreaked, conical bill, pale legs
art.build: Small, compact lark, about 14cm, about the size of a sparrow; rounded head without a crest, short neck, stands fairly upright on bare ground. Bill short, stout, conical and pointed like a finch's, shorter than the head. Legs short, with a short hind claw. At rest the long tertials cover almost the whole of the primaries, leaving little or no primary tip visible, and the tail extends beyond them. Tail medium-length, dark with white outer edges. Flight undulating; no white trailing edge to the wing.
avoid: Do not paint a band of fine dark streaks across the breast and visible primary tips beyond the tertials - that is Asian Short-toed Lark (Alaudala cheleensis).
Do not paint a crest or heavy streaking (Eurasian Skylark).
Do not paint a blackish bill or dark legs; the bill is pinkish with a grey ridge and the legs pale.
Do not paint a thin pipit-like bill.
